name: [Gear 5] Steal a Devil Fruit
desc:
Welcome to Steal a Devil Fruit!

👍 Like the game and join the group

How to Play:
👽 Buy a Devil Fruit to use its majestic powers!
🥷 Steal Fruits from other players
💸 Generate money
🐦‍🔥 Rebirth
✋ Buy swords and fight other players with your skills!

💻 Desktop, Mobile and Console players supported

Fruits: Barrier, Bomb, Chop, Clear, Darkness, Dough, Dragon, Electric, Flame, Gas, Gravity, Gum, Ice, Leopard, Light, Love, Magma, Magnet, Spin, Mammoth, Operation, Paw, Phoenix, Sand, Shadow, Smoke, Snow, Soul, Spike, String, Tremor, Venom, Gear 4, Gear 5
